criteria.requirement: Disposable check clones and isolated homes retire automatically on ordinary completion
criteria.check: Inspect lifecycle ownership and execute checks demonstrating both cold/stale allocations disappear while logs and outcome remain.

criteria.requirement: Failures and timeouts retire owned disposable resources and preserve diagnostics
criteria.check: Inspect exception handling and focused tests exercising nonzero exit and timeout with retained logs and outcomes.

criteria.requirement: Deletion stays confined to resources owned by the check run
criteria.check: Inspect path construction and retirement boundaries; focused verification must preserve siblings, caller source and retained evidence.

criteria.requirement: Cancellation handling has an honest supported boundary
criteria.check: Inspect interruption cleanup and termination limitations; do not infer abrupt process-kill cleanup from normal failure tests.

criteria.requirement: Verification reflects actual lifecycle behavior without weakening existing checks
criteria.check: Compare changed tests and implementation against baseline and run focused regressions plus the review gate.
